name: mmo-portal
description: A modular MMORPG community platform with transactional commerce and a multilingual web client.

scripts.install:apps: pnpm --dir apps/api install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/web install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/api lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/api typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.audit:prod: pnpm --dir apps/api audit --prod && pnpm --dir apps/web audit --prod
